name: Multi-Texture Trilinear Estimation
aliases: Basic Slice-based Rendering with Trilinear Interpolation
definition: An algorithm that substitutes trilinear interpolation with two bilinear interpolations and one linear interpolation to improve image quality over basic 2D texture rendering.
summary: Multi-Texture Trilinear Estimation is a slice-based volume rendering technique that reconstructs scalar values from Piecewise Regular Interval data using trilinear interpolation to improve image quality over basic 2D texture rendering.
